SMALL THINGS. BIG PERSONALITY.

Good design is
in the everyday.

01

A signature in every stroke.

Fluid graphic accents run across the spacebar, Enter and modifier keys. A small detail that brings the whole board together.

02

Two languages. One layout.

English and Russian legends share a compact layout, with dedicated arrow keys and a rotary dial at the top right.

03

Your perfect pairing.

Mix milk, denim, honey, ice blue, wine or graphite keycaps with silver, ivory, deep blue or black cases.
